tools.name: get_lead
tools.description: Fetch an inbound lead from HubSpot or Salesforce: contact, market, source, form type, message, and consent flags (marketing_opt_in, double_opt_in_confirmed, inquiry_date).

tools.name: enrich_company
tools.description: Enrich a company by web domain: name, industry, employees, revenue band, tech stack, HQ country, risk flags.

tools.name: score_lead
tools.description: Deterministic ICP score (0-100) from revenue band, stack, market, intent and industry, with tier A (>=70), B (>=45), C, or DQ (vendor pitch, competitor, student). Returns reasons.

tools.name: assign_owner
tools.description: Route the lead: tier A/B to the regional owner for its market (APAC, North America, DACH, GCC), tier C to the nurture queue. DQ leads are not routed.

tools.name: draft_email
tools.description: Save a first-reply email draft for the owner to review and send. Requires human approval. The handler re-checks consent (Spam Act AU, CASL CA, UWG DE, CAN-SPAM US) and blocks marketing without consent or without an unsubscribe line.

tools.name: log_activity
tools.description: Log a CRM activity/note on the lead (triage result, score, routing, consent decision).
